notes.title: ‘Tray + Notes + To-Do + Timer’ New Feature Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re excited to share that several highly requested features—Tray, Notes, To-Do, Timer, and more—have been completed and are now available in this update.


[hr][/hr]Major Updates
1. Tray Feature

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/9d285152061af0f0012327a34903d02db7dc5307.png"]

Option to hide the game from the taskbar and show it in the system tray.

Clicking the tray icon opens a context menu with various controls.

Added the ability to hide the mini widget via the tray menu.



2. Notes / To-Do Improvements

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/65f1122d670f76d574c76158febe72ca79a0cc65.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/09c522258eca750a0b3c0c6101a4210c22b54a88.png"]

Notes: Redesigned with a window-style interface.

To-Do: Multiple To-Do group windows can now be created.

Added a UI to view all Notes/To-Do groups at once.

Notes/To-Do group window titles can be renamed with custom text.



3. Timer Improvements

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/71fc66166e36ceaac167b3dd777bf065390fd08f.png"]

Three timer modes are now available: Session Timer, Countdown Timer, Stopwatch.

Added a compact/minimized UI option for the timer.

Session Timer can now be set to repeat indefinitely.
[hr][/hr]Other Improvements & Bug Fixes
Added an option in Settings to start the game in Mini Mode.

Improved floating UI behavior (Notes, To-Do, Timer, YouTube Browser): the selected window will now always appear on top when overlapping.

Optimized memory usage when repeatedly creating and deleting Notes/To-Do windows.

Fixed an issue where the Timer UI icon was displaying the wrong image.

Fixed the reversed scrolling behavior in the Album and Closet UI tabs.

Fixed an issue where the text caret (blinking cursor) in Notes sometimes disappeared.

Fixed a bug where the Always on Top setting for Mini Mode did not save properly and required being clicked twice.
[hr][/hr]
We are continuing development according to the Phase 2 Update Plan announced earlier.
As always, we’ll do our best to incorporate your valuable feedback into future updates.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Plan: Phase 2
notes.content:
Hello! 

Your precious Cozy Room has become even more cozy.



The update plans we announced last time have all been completed! 🎉🎉🎉

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3511030/view/518583975146423118"][/dynamiclink]While there are still many areas that need improvement among the updated content, we plan to continue making improvements, so we would be grateful if you could keep watching. 



Here are the upcoming update items planned for the future!




Upcoming Update List


1. Content Additions

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/b0dddf68b25638bf647d9960bdbc726c5b65ca92.png"]

New outfits

New theme furniture 

New rooms



2. Graphics Updates

Time of day expression: You can now set various times of day including dawn, day, evening, and night.

Weather expression: You can now set various weather conditions such as snow and rain.



3. Additional Character Placement (Companion)

Once you reach a certain level, you can place up to 1 companion in your room.

You can customize your companion's appearance and outfit.



4. Tray Mode

You can set the app to appear only in the system tray without showing in the taskbar's running programs area.



5. Mini Mode Background Image Changes

You can modify the mini mode background image (currently wooden floor) in various ways.



6. Calendar Addition

You can check completed to-do lists and Pomodoro timer progress records for past dates.

You can register schedules and receive notification messages (with sound settings available).



7. Preset Feature Addition

You can register various furniture arrangements as presets for easy switching when desired.

You can register various outfit settings as presets for easy switching when desired.

You can register various ambient sound settings as presets for easy switching when desired.



8. Music Player

You can create your own custom albums. User albums can be named directly, and you can compose the album's track list as desired by including the game's default music, DLC music, user local music, etc.

Music time seeking will be available.



9. Notepad

We're adding a new group feature for the notepad. Clicking the new group button will open a separate note window.



10. To-Do

We're adding a new group feature for the to-do list. Clicking the new group button will open a separate to-do list window.

We're adding a feature to reset all to-dos within a group.



11. Timer

We're adding a stopwatch feature.

We're adding a mini timer mode. When mini timer mode is set, the detailed time setting UI disappears and only a square-shaped clock is visible.



12. Other Feature Updates

You can change the pet's position.

We're adding a random action feature. When the random action option is activated, characters will periodically change their activities.

We plan to improve various functions and performance of the embedded browser.



Thanks to your warm interest and valuable feedback, Cozy Room continues to grow into an increasingly cozy space.

We hope to bring a little rest and comfort to your daily life today, and we'll continue to strive to provide even better experiences. 💝



Thank you.

notes.title: Update: New Furniture + New Album + Local File Playback Feature
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to share that several highly requested features—new furniture, a new album, and local file playback—have been completed and are now available in this update.

Here are the full details:


1. New Furniture and Background Skins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/dbb8ce9923ab6bec386b936ee69d0defa14a3454.png
a. More than 10 new themed furniture sets have been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/e48672dd51f5a4c50d205a20c3a6290665f69057.png
b. 10 new background skins have been added.

2. New Album: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/e5725668d0051ed374e31d5d86c48867618b8ec6.png
a. A new Acoustic Guitar album with 24 relaxing tracks has been added.

3. Local File Playback Feature
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/fc0862bd6e839682d23261a78b3f4bcb188d2731.png
a. You can now add and play music files in MP3, OGG, WAV, and FLAC formats.
(*Track sorting for local files will be supported in a future update.)


1. Web Link and Embedded Browser Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483857/01777c957c1c3d4f06fa1880e6a7af6193c9974d.png
a. Added support for external links (YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify).
(※ These links open in your default web browser and are not embedded within the game.)
b. A Beta version of the embedded player has been added. Please note that there may be limitations in functionality or performance. (*Login and live streaming are not supported.)

2. Timer Improvements
a. You can now choose from 30 different alarm sounds.
b. You can now enter timer durations manually, including decimal values (e.g., 90 seconds).
c. Maximum session and break time can now be set up to 999 minutes.

3. Memo Feature Improvements
a. When a new memo is added, the view will now automatically scroll to the new memo.

4. To-Do List Improvements
a. You can now rearrange to-do items using drag-and-drop.

5. Options
a. Added an option to launch the game automatically when Windows starts.
b. Added a feature to set an FPS limit.
c. Added an option to disable box notifications in mini mode (including during timer sessions).

6. Music Player Enhancements
a. Added the ability to exclude specific tracks from the playlist.
b. When ambient sounds or music are paused before exiting, the game will now resume with the same pause state.
c. Changed default ambient sound volume on first launch from 30% to 100%.

7. UI Improvements
a. Improved text and icon visibility when changing background images.
b. Changed the furniture category label from “Ladder” to “Decoration.”
